claim: Partitional global services exist once per partition with their control plane in a single Region; some, like AWS Network Manager, are control-plane only, while others, like IAM, have their own data plane distributed across every Region of the partition, and failures in one partition do not affect other partitions.

values.display: Partitional services provide their control plane in a single AWS Region
Failures in a partitional service do not impact other partitions

evidence.quote: Partitional services provide their control plane in a single AWS Region. Some partitional services, such as AWS Network Manager, are control plane-only and orchestrate the data plane of other services. Other partitional services, such as IAM, have their own data plane that is isolated and distributed across all of the AWS Regions in the partition. Failures in a partitional service do not impact other partitions.

claim: Edge network global services keep their control plane in the aws partition and run their data planes in the points of presence; Route 53, for example, has its control plane in us-east-1 and a data plane spread across hundreds of PoPs and every Region.

values.display: host their data planes in the global points of presence (PoP) infrastructure
Route 53 operates its control plane in the us-east-1 Region, but its data plane is distributed across hundreds of PoPs globally

evidence.quote: The next set of global AWS services have a control plane in the `aws` partition and host their data planes in the global points of presence (PoP) infrastructure (and potentially AWS Regions as well).

For example, Route 53 operates its control plane in the `us-east-1` Region, but its data plane is distributed across hundreds of PoPs globally, as well as each AWS Region (to support Route 53 Public and Private DNS within the Region).

claim: The Route 53 control plane (all public APIs for hosted zones, records, health checks and more) is hosted in us-east-1; its data plane is the authoritative DNS service running in over 200 PoP locations and in each Region.
question: Where are the Route 53 control plane and data plane?

values.display: hosted in us-east-1
runs across over 200 PoP locations as well as in each AWS Region

evidence.quote: The Route 53 control plane consists of all public Route 53 APIs covering functionality for hosted zones, records, health checks, DNS query logs, reusable delegation sets, traffic policies, and cost allocation tags. It is hosted in us-east-1. The data plane is the authoritative DNS service, which runs across over 200 PoP locations as well as in each AWS Region, answering DNS queries based on your hosted zones and health check data.
